svg.aria-label: One CSV runs through two independently written engines and a checker compares all fifteen fields of all eight drafts, so any difference fails the build.
svg.title: How parity is proved
svg.desc: The sample CSV feeds a TypeScript engine and a Python engine in parallel. A checker compares nine lead fields and six draft fields across all eight drafts. One differing character exits non-zero.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two engines, written separately, checked against each other on every build.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The browser tool and the command line tool do not share code. They share a test.

svg.text: Why bother writing the same thing twice

svg.text: A contractor who prefers a terminal gets the same wording as one who uses the browser. Without the check, the two would drift the first time

svg.text: a template changed, and nobody would notice until a homeowner got a different message than the one that was reviewed.
